entries.name: G0A.SUM
entries.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
entries.note: sum of a Vector of numbers (0 for empty)

entries.name: G0A.WORDS
entries.body: ' ' TOKENIZE [ '' EQ NOT ] FILTER
entries.note: split a String on spaces, dropping empty pieces

entries.name: G0C.ORDERS
entries.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET
entries.note: JSON text to the Vector of its order Records.

entries.name: G0A.MEAN
entries.body: 'MV' BIND MV G0A.SUM MV LENGTH DIV
entries.note: arithmetic mean of a Vector

entries.name: G0A.MOD
entries.body: 'MB' BIND 'MA' BIND MA MA MB DIV FLOOR MB MUL SUB
entries.note: a b -> a mod b (floored), lifts over Vectors

entries.name: G0A.SUMBY
entries.body: GROUP 'GR' BIND GR KEYS GR VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
entries.note: keys values -> Record key to sum of its values, first-appearance order

entries.name: G0A.DEVS
entries.body: 'DV' BIND DV DV G0A.MEAN SUB
entries.note: each number minus the mean

entries.name: G0A.VAR
entries.body: G0A.DEVS 'VD' BIND VD VD MUL G0A.MEAN
entries.note: population variance

entries.name: G0C.MAXV
entries.body: 'LX' BIND LX LX 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD
entries.note: Largest element of a non-empty numeric Vector.

entries.name: G0B.CAP
entries.body: CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 0 GET UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
entries.note: upper-case the first letter of a String

entries.name: G0C.LINE
entries.body: 'LR' BIND LR 'qty' GET LR 'price' GET MUL
entries.note: qty times price of one order Record.

entries.name: G0A.ARGMAX
entries.body: -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET
entries.note: index of the largest number in a Vector, first on ties

entries.name: G0A.TOPKEY
entries.body: 'TK' BIND TK KEYS TK VALUES G0A.ARGMAX GET
entries.note: key of a Record whose numeric value is largest, first on ties

entries.name: G0B.SPACED
entries.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
entries.note: Vector of Strings joined with single spaces

entries.name: G0B.COUNT
entries.body: NOT [ NOT ] FILTER LENGTH
entries.note: number of TRUE lanes in a Vector of truths

entries.name: G0D.MAXV
entries.body: SORT -1 GET
entries.note: Largest element of a Vector of numbers or Strings.

entries.name: G0A.DIVISORS
entries.body: 'DN' BIND 1 DN RANGE 'DR' BIND DR DN DR G0A.MOD 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 EQ ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
entries.note: positive divisors of a positive integer, ascending

entries.name: G0A.SPAN
entries.body: SORT 'SP' BIND SP -1 GET SP 0 GET SUB
entries.note: largest minus smallest

entries.name: G0B.DIVISORS
entries.body: 'DN' BIND 1 DN RANGE 'DK' BIND DN DK DIV 'DQ' BIND 0 DK DQ DQ FLOOR SUB 0 GT SELECT [ 0 GT ] FILTER
entries.note: positive divisors of a positive integer, ascending

entries.name: G0C.DIVIDES
entries.body: 'LN' BIND 'LD' BIND LN LD DIV FLOOR LN LD DIV EQ
entries.note: Stack pair [d n] to TRUE when d divides n exactly (d nonzero).

entries.name: G0C.SQ
entries.body: 'LX' BIND LX LX MUL
entries.note: Square of a number.

entries.name: G0C.MINV
entries.body: 'LX' BIND LX LX 0 GET [ MIN ] FOLD
entries.note: Smallest element of a non-empty numeric Vector.

entries.name: G0D.DIVISORS
entries.body: 'K' BIND 1 K RANGE [ 'D' BIND K K D DIV FLOOR D MUL SUB 0 EQ ] FILTER
entries.note: Ascending Vector of the positive divisors of a positive integer.

entries.name: G0D.MINV
entries.body: SORT 0 GET
entries.note: Smallest element of a Vector of numbers or Strings.

entries.name: G0A.CSTEP
entries.body: 'CX' BIND CX 2 DIV CX 3 MUL 1 ADD CX 2 G0A.MOD 0 EQ SELECT 'CY' BIND 1 CY CX 1 EQ SELECT
entries.note: one Collatz step, with 1 fixed at 1

entries.name: G0A.COLLATZ
entries.body: 'CN' BIND 1 120 RANGE CN [ 'CE' BIND G0A.CSTEP ] SCAN 'CS' BIND CN 1 COLLECT CS CONCAT [ 1 EQ NOT ] FILTER LENGTH
entries.note: Collatz step count to reach 1 (inputs whose count is at most 120)

entries.name: G0B.BINARY
entries.body: 'BN' BIND [ 32 16 8 4 2 1 ] 'BP' BIND BN BP DIV FLOOR 'BQ' BIND BQ BQ 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB STR BP BN GT G0B.COUNT DROP JOIN
entries.note: integer 1..63 as a base-2 String without leading zeros

entries.name: G0B.CSTEP
entries.body: 'CX' BIND 3 CX MUL 1 ADD CX 2 DIV CX 2 G0A.MOD 0 GT SELECT 'CY' BIND 1 CY CX 1 EQ SELECT
entries.note: one Collatz step, with 1 staying at 1

entries.name: G0C.ISPRIME
entries.body: 'LK' BIND 1 LK RANGE [ LK G0C.DIVIDES ] FILTER LENGTH 2 EQ
entries.note: TRUE when the integer k has exactly two divisors in 1..k.

entries.name: G0C.COLSTEP
entries.body: 'LE' BIND 'LV' BIND 1 LV 2 DIV LV 3 MUL 1 ADD LV 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL LV EQ SELECT LV 1 EQ SELECT
entries.note: SCAN block [acc elem] to the next Collatz value; 1 stays 1, the element is ignored.

entries.name: G0C.MAXKEYS
entries.body: 'LR' BIND LR VALUES G0C.MAXV 'LM' BIND LR KEYS LR VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET LM EQ ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
entries.note: Record to the Vector of keys whose value is the largest, in order.

entries.name: G0C.ARGMAXKEY
entries.body: G0C.MAXKEYS 0 GET
entries.note: Record to the first key (in order) whose value is the largest.

entries.name: G0D.IS-PRIME
entries.body: G0D.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ
entries.note: Whether a positive integer is prime.

entries.name: G0D.PRIMES
entries.body: 'N' BIND 1 N RANGE [ G0D.IS-PRIME ] FILTER
entries.note: Ascending Vector of the primes <= a positive integer (empty for 1).

entries.name: G0D.BINARY
entries.body: 'N' BIND [ 32 16 8 4 2 1 ] [ 'P' BIND N P DIV FLOOR 2 G0A.MOD ] MAP STR JOIN 'S' BIND S CHARS S '1' SEARCH DROP JOIN
entries.note: An integer 1..63 written in base 2 as a String without leading zeros.

entries.name: G0D.COLLATZ-STEP
entries.body: 'I' BIND [ 'X' 'C' ] BIND X X 2 DIV X 3 MUL 1 ADD X 2 G0A.MOD 0 EQ SELECT X 1 EQ SELECT C C 1 ADD X 1 EQ SELECT 2 COLLECT
entries.note: FOLD step over [ value steps ]: applies one Collatz move unless value is already 1; the second operand (the fold element) is ignored.

entries.name: G0D.COLLATZ
entries.body: 'N' BIND 1 130 RANGE N 0 2 COLLECT [ G0D.COLLATZ-STEP ] FOLD 1 GET
entries.note: Number of Collatz steps to reach 1 for an integer 1..60 (130 bounded iterations).

entries.name: G0D.FIB-INDEX
entries.note: Smallest k with F(k) >= n (F(1)=F(2)=1), for n up to 987.

entries.name: G0D.JOIN-WITH
entries.body: 'S' BIND [ 'W' BIND S W 2 COLLECT ] MAP FLATTEN 'F' BIND F 0 1 F LENGTH 0 EQ SELECT DROP JOIN
entries.note: vector sep G0D.JOIN-WITH joins a Vector of Strings with the separator between them ('' for an empty Vector).
